mapper.select: SELECT i.*, c.name AS client_name FROM invoices i JOIN clients c ON i.client_id = c.id WHERE i.id = #{id}
SELECT i.*, c.name AS client_name FROM invoices i JOIN clients c ON i.client_id = c.id WHERE i.invoice_number = #{invoiceNumber}
SELECT i.*, c.name AS client_name FROM invoices i JOIN clients c ON i.client_id = c.id ORDER BY i.billing_year DESC, i.billing_month DESC, c.name
SELECT i.*, c.name AS client_name FROM invoices i JOIN clients c ON i.client_id = c.id WHERE i.client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY i.billing_year DESC, i.billing_month DESC
SELECT i.*, c.name AS client_name FROM invoices i JOIN clients c ON i.client_id = c.id WHERE i.billing_month = #{billingMonth} AND i.billing_year = #{billingYear} ORDER BY c.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoices (invoice_number, bill_id, client_id, billing_month, billing_year, issue_date, due_date, total_amount_usd, total_amount_lbp, exchange_rate, status, notes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{invoiceNumber}, #{billId}, #{clientId}, #{billingMonth}, #{billingYear}, #{issueDate}, #{dueDate}, #{totalAmountUsd}, #{totalAmountLbp}, #{exchangeRate}, #{status}, #{notes}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE invoices SET invoice_number = #{invoiceNumber}, bill_id = #{billId}, client_id = #{clientId}, billing_month = #{billingMonth}, billing_year = #{billingYear}, issue_date = #{issueDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, total_amount_usd = #{totalAmountUsd}, total_amount_lbp = #{totalAmountLbp}, exchange_rate = #{exchangeRate}, status = #{status}, notes = #{notes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE invoices SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
